# NEORM-ERA by Taurus AI

> AI Agentic Studio for Performance Marketing. Seven specialized engines from brief to creative, social autopilot, and predictive ROAS.

## Company & Jurisdiction
- Platform: NEORM-ERA
- Operating Parent & Signatory: TAURUS AI Corp.
- Jurisdiction: Canada — Federal Corporation (CBCA 1001270625)
- Operations: Worldwide (Canada, United States, UAE, GCC, India)
- Official Domain: https://www.neorm-era.com
- Contact: admin@taurusai.io

## The Seven Engines

### 1. Neormative Ads (Creative Studio)
- Route: /creative/
- Canonical URL: https://www.neorm-era.com/creative/
- Description: AI campaign and creative generation. Generates editorial-grade ad concepts, multi-platform copy variants, visual briefs, and heuristic ad scoring for performance marketing.
- Target Audience: E-commerce, direct-to-consumer, luxury retail, and growth marketing teams.

### 2. Neormedia Sync (Social Autopilot)
- Route: /social/
- Canonical URL: https://www.neorm-era.com/social/
- Description: Autonomous multi-platform distribution and engagement. Manages scheduling, publishing, and customer responses across Meta (Facebook & Instagram), WhatsApp Business, and Google Business Profile.
- Target Audience: Local retail, clinics, salons, hospitality, and SMBs across UAE, GCC, and India.

### 3. Neormintel Data (Predictive ROAS)
- Route: /intel/
- Canonical URL: https://www.neorm-era.com/intel/
- Description: Real-time marketing intelligence and attribution. Connects ad accounts, web events, review channels, and AI-search visibility with predictive ROAS modeling and CPL anomaly alerts.
- Target Audience: CMOs, performance marketing leads, and analytical media buyers.

### 4. Neormestra Flow (Orchestration)
- Route: /flow/
- Canonical URL: https://www.neorm-era.com/flow/
- Description: Agentic workflow orchestration. Coordinates multi-agent campaign pipelines across brief ingestion, creative approval, automated distribution, and performance feedback loops.
- Target Audience: Enterprise marketing operations and high-velocity digital brands.

### 5. Neormestate Reels (Real Estate AI Marketing)
- Route: /estate/
- Canonical URL: https://www.neorm-era.com/estate/
- Description: Automated real estate marketing vertical. Ingests MLS or property listing URLs and automatically renders 9:16 vertical video walkthrough tours and hyper-local Meta lead ads in under 90 seconds.
- Target Audience: Real estate brokerages, property developers, and independent real estate agents.

### 6. Neormeo Authority (GEO & AI Search)
- Route: /seo/
- Canonical URL: https://www.neorm-era.com/seo/
- Description: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO/AEO). Injects automated Schema.org structured data and tunes brand knowledge graphs for maximum citation authority across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google Gemini, and AI search engines.
- Target Audience: B2B brands, founders, agencies, and high-consideration consumer brands.

### 7. Neormence Studio (Agency Workspace)
- Route: /freelance/
- Canonical URL: https://www.neorm-era.com/freelance/
- Description: White-label collaborative agency workspace. Secure sandbox providing client portals, design knowledge base RAG, and production component export with strict brand asset isolation.
- Target Audience: Digital marketing agencies, creative studios, and freelance marketing collectives.

## Technology & Design Standards
- Architecture: Edge-optimized, static-first with serverless API functions.
- Core Tenet: Organic Design System with paper/ink contrast, strict typography scales, and zero generic WebGL gradient blobs.
- Performance: Sub-300ms LCP with high-priority preloaded WebP posters and progressive progressive enhancement.
